{"params": {"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"ISO 4032 M5 across flats; couldn't be measured"},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_clear":{"value":5.6,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"through-hole for M5 bolt below nut"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"asked"},"knob_h":{"value":12,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"pocket_depth":{"value":5.2,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"nut_h + 0.5 so nut sits fully below top face"},"pocket_clear":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"hex pocket AF = nut_af + this; ribs provide the grip"},"rib_protrude":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"crush-rib height from each flat (7.70 mm across ribs); set to the coupon winner"},"rib_w":{"value":1.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lead_in":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"n_scallops":{"value":8,"kind":"design","unit":"count","source":"design"},"scallop_r":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"rib_a":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"coupon pocket 1 (1 dot), 7.90 across ribs"},"rib_b":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"coupon pocket 2 (2 dots), 7.70 across ribs"},"rib_c":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"coupon pocket 3 (3 dots), 7.50 across ribs"}}, "parts": [{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat bottom face on bed, nut pocket opening facing up","use_orientation":"nut pocket faces away from the work; bolt comes up through the bottom hole into the nut","code":"import math
def build(p):
    H=p.knob_h; D=p.knob_d
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(D/2).extrude(H).edges('>Z').fillet(1.5).edges('<Z').chamfer(0.4)
    for i in range(int(p.n_scallops)):
        a=2*math.pi*i/p.n_scallops
        r=D/2+p.scallop_r*0.4
        s=cq.Workplane('XY').center(r*math.cos(a),r*math.sin(a)).circle(p.scallop_r).extrude(H)
        body=body.cut(s)
    af=p.nut_af+p.pocket_clear
    cd=af/math.cos(math.radians(30))
    z0=H-p.pocket_depth
    pocket=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).polygon(6,cd).extrude(p.pocket_depth+1)
    body=body.cut(pocket)
    cone=cq.Solid.makeCone(cd/2, cd/2+p.lead_in, p.lead_in+0.01, cq.Vector(0,0,H-p.lead_in), cq.Vector(0,0,1))
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').add(cone))
    rh=p.pocket_depth-p.lead_in
    L=p.rib_protrude+0.5
    rc=af/2-p.rib_protrude+L/2
    for k in range(6):
        rib=cq.Workplane('XY').box(L,p.rib_w,rh,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((rc,0,z0)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),30+60*k)
        body=body.union(rib)
    hole=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.bolt_clear/2).extrude(H)
    return body.cut(hole)
"},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat bottom on bed, pockets facing up","use_orientation":"held in hand to test-press the nut","code":"import math
def build(p):
    H=p.pocket_depth+1.5
    blk=cq.Workplane('XY').box(42,15,H,centered=(True,True,False))
    af=p.nut_af+p.pocket_clear
    cd=af/math.cos(math.radians(30))
    z0=H-p.pocket_depth
    rh=p.pocket_depth-p.lead_in
    for j,rp in enumerate([p.rib_a,p.rib_b,p.rib_c]):
        x=(j-1)*13.5
        blk=blk.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).center(x,0).polygon(6,cd).extrude(p.pocket_depth+1))
        cone=cq.Solid.makeCone(cd/2,cd/2+p.lead_in,p.lead_in+0.01,cq.Vector(x,0,H-p.lead_in),cq.Vector(0,0,1))
        blk=blk.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').add(cone))
        L=rp+0.5; rc=af/2-rp+L/2
        for k in range(6):
            blk=blk.union(cq.Workplane('XY').box(L,p.rib_w,rh,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((rc,0,z0)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),30+60*k).translate((x,0,0)))
        blk=blk.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').center(x,0).circle(p.bolt_clear/2).extrude(H))
        for d in range(j+1):
            blk=blk.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-0.6).center(x-2+d*2,6.3).circle(0.5).extrude(1))
    return blk
